{
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "is_outage", "analytical_usefulness": 0.55, "source_groundedness": 0.92, "rationale": "A binary outage flag is a useful axis for support burden, but it is largely redundant with is_outage_or_incident. Values are well grounded in the source text (CS-0003 outage correctly true)."},
    {"name": "customer_impact_scope", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Scope of impact (tenant-wide vs single user) is a strong burden-differentiating axis. Values mostly sound, though CS-0001 and CS-0005 labeled single_user is a defensible reading; not_present for a feature request is reasonable."},
    {"name": "issue_category", "analytical_usefulness": 0.9, "source_groundedness": 0.88, "rationale": "Core grouping dimension directly answering which issue types dominate. Categorizations align well with source text across samples."},
    {"name": "request_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Useful but substantially overlaps with issue_category (bug vs feature vs outage). Grounded, though CS-0003 categorized bug_platform_defect yet request_type production_outage_urgent shows slight taxonomy inconsistency across the pair."},
    {"name": "system_component", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.82, "rationale": "Affected component is a valuable axis for locating burden. Mostly grounded; CS-0003 mapped to api_endpoint (502 gateway) is reasonable inference."},
    {"name": "data_risk", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Data-risk categorization adds a severity axis relevant to burden. Values well supported (billing duplicate, CSV corruption)."},
    {"name": "blocker_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "rationale": "Blocker/business-impact axis is useful for prioritization. However customer_business_blocked=134 appears over-applied; CS-0002 marked customer_business_blocked while blocker_or_dependency marked not_present shows inconsistency and possible over-assertion."},
    {"name": "technical_root_cause", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.65, "rationale": "Root-cause pattern is analytically valuable but often inferred beyond what text supports; e.g., CS-0003 'infrastructure_resource_exhaustion' from a 502 error, and CS-0001 'configuration_or_state_inconsistency' for a billing duplicate are speculative confident specifics."},
    {"name": "is_outage_or_incident", "analytical_usefulness": 0.3, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Nearly duplicates is_outage with slightly different counts; adds little new leverage. Values grounded."},
    {"name": "system_component_affected", "analytical_usefulness": 0.3, "source_groundedness": 0.8, "rationale": "Near-duplicate of system_component with differing not_present counts; provides little additional analytical axis despite reasonable grounding."},
    {"name": "blocker_or_dependency", "analytical_usefulness": 0.3, "source_groundedness": 0.78, "rationale": "Restates blocker_type with different distributions, and the two disagree per-row (CS-0002), signaling redundancy plus inconsistency rather than a new axis."},
    {"name": "data_risk_or_exposure", "analytical_usefulness": 0.3, "source_groundedness": 0.83, "rationale": "Near-duplicate of data_risk with slightly shifted counts; minimal new leverage."},
    {"name": "technical_root_cause_pattern", "analytical_usefulness": 0.3, "source_groundedness": 0.63, "rationale": "Restates technical_root_cause with different distributions and shares its speculative grounding weakness; redundant."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.62,
  "source_groundedness": 0.8,
  "rationale": "The distinct columns (issue_category, customer_impact_scope, system_component, data_risk, blocker_type) give genuine, complementary axes for analyzing support burden and are largely well grounded in the ticket text. However nearly half the set consists of near-duplicate pairs (is_outage/is_outage_or_incident, system_component/system_component_affected, blocker_type/blocker_or_dependency, data_risk/data_risk_or_exposure, technical_root_cause/technical_root_cause_pattern) that restate each other with only shifted distributions, adding little leverage and even contradicting their twins on some rows. Grounding is generally sound for extractive/categorical columns; the root-cause columns show the most speculative, unsupported confident specifics."
}
